meta.comment: engine.traffic (planned MOD) inc0 table (d)+(e): link capacity per road/rail/tube class in pcu/h/lane and trains/h, plus the BPR-style congestion curve. Road link capacities key to data/roads.json's 11 class ids by reference (roadClassId field); this file adds ONLY the new figure roads.json does not carry -- capacityPcuPerLanePerHour -- it does not restate lanes/speedLimit/baseCostPounds (GR#3). The BPR alpha/beta/capacityPerLanePerHour DEFAULTS already live in data/traffic.json -- referenced by field name only, not restated (BUG-824); this file adds PER-CLASS overrides only, since traffic.json's single default is network-wide and (e) explicitly calls for per-class variation.
meta.unitsConvention: capacityPcuPerLanePerHour = passenger-car-unit throughput per lane per hour (HCM 2010/2016 convention); trainsPerHourMax = maximum scheduled trains/hour on the class; passengersPerTrain cross-references vehicle_classes.json fixedTrack rows (not restated).

roadClassSource.source: HCM 2010/2016 (Highway Capacity Manual, TRB) base-capacity orders of magnitude for the class ladder shape, calibrated to the exact anchor figures Aaron's brief specifies for residential/minor/A-road/dual/motorway; the 6 remaining classes interpolated between those anchors by lane count and functional tier.
roadClassSource.note: The five brief-specified anchors (residential 600, minor 900, A-road 1800, dual 2100, motorway 2300) are treated as confidence: derived (Aaron-specified, not independently re-measured); the six interpolated classes are confidence: derived (interpolation).

defaultCapacityPerLanePerHour.note: referenced, not restated -- this file's roadClasses[].capacityPcuPerLanePerHour is the PER-CLASS refinement of that single network-wide default

bprCurve.formula: t = t0 * (1 + alpha * (v/c)^beta), where v = per-lane volume (pcu/h), c = capacityPcuPerLanePerHour for the segment's road class (this file), t0 = free-flow travel time on the segment (from data/roads.json speedLimit and segment length).

perClassOverrides.$comment: Classes whose real-world volume-delay behaviour deviates from the network default alpha/beta (BPR's original 0.15/4.0 was calibrated on US arterial/freeway data; dense urban low-speed classes show steeper, earlier-onset delay -- HCM 2010 Ch.18 urban street methodology). Directional placeholder overrides pending Aaron's balance pass.

alley.source: derived approximation (steeper delay onset on a single-lane local street)

motorway.source: derived approximation (motorways sustain higher v/c before breakdown, per HCM freeway methodology, before hard breakdown); beta omitted -- identical to data/traffic.json's network-default bprBeta 4.0, restating it violated this block's own referenced-not-restated discipline (BUG-843)

railClasses.note: street-running headway-limited, not a full rail block-signalling system

railClassSource.source: Brief-specified anchors (rail 12-24tph, HS1 up to 18tph, tube 30-36tph) cross-checked against real-world UK signalling headway orders of magnitude (Network Rail/TfL published capacity figures, mapping sanity-check only).

provenance.note: Every roadClassId and railClass id used here must resolve against data/roads.json's classes[].id (roads) and this file's own railClasses[].id (rail/tram/metro) -- see FEAT-2326609792-inc0.md AC for the cross-reference check.
